name: triple-jeopardy
description: Triple Jeopardy - social publishing with campaign sign-off. A Positive Force FL tool. Phase 0 skeleton.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix worker
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,worker,tick -c cyan,magenta,gray "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix worker" "node scripts/dev-tick.mjs"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix worker
